fact_check.claim: No Zipcar in Ithaca; Cornell points to Ithaca Carshare
fact_check.note: Brief cross-check; Cornell sustainability page names Ithaca Carshare and does not mention Zipcar.

fact_check.claim: About 20 vehicles, maintenance and insurance included; pods in Downtown, Northside, Southside, Fall Creek, Collegetown, West End, East Hill; office weekdays 9 to 5
Fleet includes fuel-efficient cars, a minivan, a pickup; 24/7 access
fact_check.note: Fetched; the page says this. Also brief §2.20.

fact_check.claim: Student plans: Just In Case $30/yr + $9/hr, It's My Car $310/yr + $6/hr, each $45 off; up to two drivers; IC and TC3 qualify; no discount on monthly
Community plans $7.50/mo or $75/yr; $35/mo or $355/yr; $20 non-refundable sign-up per driver; mileage 42/44/52 cents
Taxes 8% sales + 12% rental; page said whether they apply to mileage is our assumption
fact_check.note: fixed in place: Rates and student pages say both taxes are added to hourly and mileage charges. Replaced the 'our assumption' sentence with the source's statement. The 20% on miles in our math is therefore correct.

fact_check.claim: 10-hour daily cap, excluding highest-demand cars
It's My Car includes gas/EV charging, maintenance, insurance
fact_check.note: Fetched; page says the student page lists this for It's My Car only, as the source does.

fact_check.claim: Four on-campus pickup spots plus four in Collegetown and nearby
Eligibility table: 18+, license 2 years, no suspension in 3 years; under 21 own policy with $300,000 liability; IDP not accepted; some countries cannot be approved; (607) 277-3210
fact_check.note: Matches brief; 2-year vs 3-year lookback disclosed on the page as the brief advises.

fact_check.claim: Easy Access plan $10/mo + $6/hr with $20/mo driving credits (Summer 2024 handbook)
fact_check.note: Matches brief; page marks eligibility as not confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Break-even about 93 hours (280/3) and about 78 with tax (280/3.60); about 39 two-hour trips
Junior example: 32 hours, 128 miles; JIC $460.11, IMC $624.91, JIC wins by $164.80
Winter break: four 2-hour, 8-mile runs cost about $152.53 first year with sign-up
Resident permit $752.98; commuter permit $359.77
Permit vs Carshare: 752.98-310-20 = $422.98; about 70 hours at $6; about 59 at $7.20
Profile: 20 hours IMC plus four NYC OurBus round trips at $33 floor = $714
Summer: 3 months monthly JIC $22.50; 12 months $90; OmniRide expires Aug 31
TCAT $1.50 a ride; free for upper-years after 6 p.m. weekdays and all weekend; lost free daytime TCAT after first year
Bikeshare 20-minute trip $6.50 before tax
Dining usually closed the week the university closes
54% of Carshare trips by on-campus Cornell students were grocery runs (2013-era Cornell report)
fact_check.note: In the brief (trusted), attributed to a search summary of the Cornell sustainability page. The fetch of that page did not return the 54% figure, so the page's link may not show it now. Left as the brief states it.

fact_check.claim: 2012-13: 584 Cornell students and 237 employees used the membership incentive
Shutdown May 2023 (insurer left, Vermont risk retention group); returned March 2024 with 12 cars, down from 30, goal 20
2008: It's My Car was $200 a year plus $4.95 an hour and 20 cents a mile
fact_check.note: fixed in place: Numbers confirmed ($200, $4.95, $0.20), but the 2008 article does not use the name It's My Car; it calls it the frequent-use plan. Changed the wording to 'the frequent-use plan'.

fact_check.claim: Five sources from 2016 to 2024 treat car share as a safety net; 2016 College Confidential posters told a first-year to skip the car; 2023 Sun grad student used Carshare as backup then Bikeshare and planned to buy a car
fact_check.source_url: brief §6 and §9 forum and Sun rows
fact_check.note: Attributions consistent with the brief rows on these sources; page adds no detail beyond them.
